results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: Technical Report for ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Adaptive Point Cloud Understanding for Heterogeneous Robotic Systems
results.snippet: This technical report presents the implementation details of the winning solution for the ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge. This challenge focuses on semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds from diverse unstructured outdoor environments collected from multiple robotic platforms. This problem was addressed by implementing Point Prompt Tuning (PPT) integrated with Point Transformer v3 (PTv3) backbone, enabling adaptive processing of heterogeneous LiDAR data through platform-specific conditioning and cross-dataset class alignment strategies. The model is trained without requir…

results.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
results.snippet: Video world models can generate realistic futures from a single instruction, but they often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time. As a result, the generated videos appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution, such as robot manipulation. We present GEM-4D, a geometry-grounded video world model that resolves this limitation by injecting dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model into the video generative backbone during training. This supervision enables the model to jointly ca…

findings.point: GEM-4D 提出了一种几何增强的视频世界模型，专门用于机器人操作任务，解决了视频世界模型在时间维度上难以一致追踪同一物理点的问题，为动作执行提供了物理 grounding。
findings.evidence: 论文指出视频世界模型虽能从单条指令生成逼真未来，但常无法跨时间一致追踪物理点，导致生成视频缺乏可靠动作执行所需的物理 grounding；GEM-4D 通过几何 grounding 解决此限制。
findings.attention: 中，arXiv 新投稿，直接针对机器人操作世界模型的核心痛点（几何一致性），但尚无引用/星标等热度指标
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆，直接切中“机器人操作世界模型”前沿，提出几何 grounding 机制，值得跟踪后续实验与开源情况

findings.point: ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D 语义分割挑战赛聚焦多机器人平台采集的非结构化户外环境点云语义分割，冠军方案采用 Point Prompt Tuning (PPT) 结合 Point Transformer，体现了 3D 感知在异构机器人系统中的最新进展。
findings.evidence: 技术报告记录了 ICRA 2025 GOOSE 挑战赛获胜方案，任务为多机器人平台采集的户外非结构化环境 3D 点云语义分割，方法为 PPT + Point Transformer。

results.snippet:
Abstract 
                 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robotic manipulation, enabling robots to execute natural language commands through end-to-end learning from visual observations. However, deploying large-scale VLA models on affordable robotic platforms remains challenging due to computational constraints and the need for efficient adaptation to new robot embodiments. This paper presents an efficient fine-tuning methodology and real-world deployment analysis for adapting VLA models to low-cost robotic manipulation systems. We propose a…

results.snippet: Robot manipulation in the real world is fundamentally constrained by the visual sim2real gap, where depth observations collected in simulation fail to reflect the complex noise patterns inherent to real sensors. In this work, inspired by the denoising capability of diffusion models, we invert the conventional perspective and propose a clean-to-noisy paradigm that learns to synthesize noisy depth, thereby bridging the visual sim2real gap through purely simulation-driven robotic learning. results.title: SERF: Spatiotemporal Environment and Robot Feature Map for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
results.snippet: Long-horizon robot mobile manipulation requires continual reasoning about localization, environment changes, and task progress, all of which are challenging to infer from image observations alone. In this paper, we show that conditioning a mobile manipulation policy on a spatiotemporal feature map improves reasoning over long horizons. The map represents the environment and the articulated robot body as neural points in a shared latent space and is updated online from egocentric observations and proprioceptive state. # 机器人操作与世界模型：前沿进展与产业动态增量快照（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-11-23（UTC） | **领域**：具身智能 / 机器人操作 / 世界模型 / VLA / Sim2Real | **检索源数量**：31 条可引用证据源

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

### 1.1 一句话增量判断
**近 1-2 年核心增量**：视频世界模型从“生成逼真视频”转向“几何一致的物理 grounding”（GEM-4D [1]）；长时程移动操作引入时空特征图显式建模环境演化（SERF [2]）；Sim2Real 深度扩散桥接真实传感器噪声（RealD²iff [3]）；基础模型透明度指数化推动合规与可审计部署（FMTI 2025 [4]）。

### 1.2 关键进展条目（按时间倒序）

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点（Bottleneck & Inflection）

### 4.1 一句话增量判断
**核心瓶颈**：**数据规模与质量**（大规模高质量机器人轨迹数据稀缺，AgiBot Colosseo [19] 等尝试填补）、**几何一致性与物理合理性的理论保证**（GEM-4D [1] 等初步探索）、**Sim2Real 深度域桥接的泛化性**（RealD²iff [3] 仅针对深度观测）、**长时程推理的显式记忆机制**（SERF [2] 引入时空特征图但扩展性待验证）、**推理算力与延迟**（LoRA [18] 等轻量化方案尚未大规模验证）。**拐点信号**：NVIDIA 全栈平台闭环 [17]、基础模型开放权重化 [8]、大规模数据平台成熟 [19]、透明度指数化推动合规 [4]、长时程 VLA 专项突破 [7]——若 2026 下半年出现“开源世界模型在 ≥3 种本体、≥10 任务、真机成功率 ≥80%”的可复现报告，将标志着从实验室走向工程化的拐点到来。
